brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536×864 pixels or larger. Create exactly one finished image.

Design: approved Japanese basketball thumbnail style: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, warm off-white huge bold Japanese typography, hand-drawn ink and scratchy brush illustration, high contrast, restrained information, professional editorial hierarchy. The style reference observed was B-culver-black-lime-v3.png; carry over ONLY its color/ink language, NOT its player, pose, date, names or stats.

Composition: left 55% is a clean text block; right 45% a single large dynamic real-player illustration. Leave generous safe margins (at least 5%) around every word. Use a sweeping lime brush arc behind the player to evoke rebound motion, no realistic court, hoop or scoreboard. Intentional waist/thigh crop is fine, but entire head, both forearms, hands and basketball must be visible. Keep body and letters separate.

Subject: Jack Cooley, the real Ryukyu Golden Kings player, based on his official club profile photo inspected for this job at https://goldenkings.jp/team/players/detail/id=14102?PlayerID=26914 . He is the most prominent offensive player in the supplied article (not a random choice).
Observed appearance from the official portrait: light skin, short dark brown hair with short sides and a neat side sweep on top, fairly broad forehead, angular broad jaw and slightly long rectangular face, straight prominent nose, light-colored eyes, short close brown stubble around jaw/chin and upper lip (not a long or full beard), powerful stocky shoulders and thick strong arms. Preserve these identity-specific features in the expressive ink drawing. Avoid generic heroic substitute face.
Action: three-quarter view, torso twisting in a strong basketball rebound-gather posture; both hands firmly grip one orange basketball above shoulder level slightly to the right of his head; face clearly visible, gaze focused toward the ball. Draw realistic, clean anatomy: exactly two arms and two hands with natural fingers gripping the ball. This is a conceptual sports illustration, not a reenactment of any actual game moment. No other people.
Uniform: plain off-white/light gold sleeveless basketball jersey with simple dark edging, no text, no jersey number, no patterns or emblems. Absolutely no team/league/sponsor/manufacturer logos. Do not paste or reproduce the official photograph; illustration only, coarse brush and ink hatch shading, never photorealistic.

Text (verbatim, only these six lines):
"琉球 直近5試合"
"2勝3敗"
"2P得点差 −40点"
"5試合合計（11/7〜11/18）"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"成績をもとにしたイメージ"

Text hierarchy: first line bold off-white team/period heading; second line extremely large bold lime centerpiece; third line bold off-white, with −40 accented lime if useful; fourth line clearly readable below the statistic, not tiny. Fifth and sixth lines in small but legible off-white type along bottom left, clear of the body illustration. Require correct Japanese characters and correct negative sign. The −40 is the TEAM's cumulative two-point scoring difference across five games, not a player's score and not a single-game result. All claims and numbers come exclusively from supplied source.html/source.txt. Do not add league rankings, individual stats, injury news, promises, dates or text not listed.

Finish: sharp thumbnail-scale legibility, lively but minimal ink/brush texture, no clutter, no badges, no logos, no photo collages, no watermarks, opaque background.

generator.inspection: 生成画像を実際に表示して、文字・数値・留保・容姿・顔と両手とボールの形・文字の見切れ・AI表示を目視確認。修正なしで合格。
